ticket.description: Hej, jeg hedder Mette Sørensen fra Contoso ApS. Mit cpr er 010190-1234.

comments.body: Intern note: kunden er CFO hos Contoso, se sag hos Lars Nielsen.
comments.plain_body: Intern note: kunden er CFO hos Contoso, se sag hos Lars Nielsen.

reasons.mette_soerensen: the lower-case, ASCII-transliterated tag IS caught by GLiNER (config/gliner.json threshold 0.65, 'person name' label scores 0.74-0.89 on this bare tag with no surrounding context) — this is the asserted Danish pass-2 recall win. 'Mette' and 'Sørensen' as bare given/family names are NOT separately asserted here because both still leak from a different, unrelated source: the 'faktura_MetteSørensen.pdf' attachment filename (see reasons below) — so a whole-string 'absent' check on 'Mette'/'Sørensen' would still fail even though the tag itself is fully closed
reasons.Mette: the tag-based leak this name used to be blamed on ('mette_soerensen') IS now closed by GLiNER — see the 'mette_soerensen' reason above. The residual leak comes solely from the 'faktura_MetteSørensen.pdf' attachment filename (name embedded with no surrounding spaces), which GLiNER cannot close without an unacceptable over-redaction — see 'Sørensen' below and tests/fixtures/tickets/attachments.json's matching reason. Kept here as a recorded, measured gap; not asserted in expectedPass2.absent
reasons.Sørensen: leaks via the 'faktura_MetteSørensen.pdf' attachment filename (name embedded with no surrounding spaces). GLiNER can be made to flag the whole filename as an entity (a 'file name containing a person name'-style label scores ~0.32-0.45 on it, comfortably below scores for plain false positives like the 'partner'/'gold_tier' tags at the same threshold), but the span it returns covers the ENTIRE filename, not just the embedded name — redacting it would also remove 'faktura' from output, which tests/fixtures/tickets/attachments.json's expected.present requires stay visible. No threshold/label change closes this leak without that regression, so it is a genuine Plan-2 recall gap, not tuned away; kept here as a recorded gap, not asserted in expectedPass2.absent (see attachments.json for the same finding)
